hero.lede: What we collect, what stays in your browser, and who else loads on these pages.

p: Anonymous page views only after you press Accept in the consent banner. We store that choice under kga-consent-v1 in your browser. No query strings are sent.
Contact form entries never touch our servers: pressing Send opens WhatsApp with your message text. What you send there is governed by WhatsApp.
Event calendar cache (kga-cal-v1) lives in your browser localStorage to paint schedules fast. Clear site data anytime to remove it.

Google Analytics (page views), Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights (performance), Spotify embeds (music players), MapLibre with CARTO basemap (distribution map), Cloudinary (images), and font CDN. Each loads only on pages that need it and may set its own cookies.
Decline analytics in the banner, clear browser storage, or contact us to ask what we hold. We hold no accounts and no server-side profiles.

hero.lede: Simple rules for browsing, ordering, and reusing our work.

p: Catalog listings describe North Moluccan staples with pack sizes, specs, and prices. Pressing Order opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message; the sale completes there, not on this site.
Availability, harvest batches, and shipping are confirmed in chat before payment. If in doubt, ask us first.
Text, images, music, and artwork on this site belong to Kagōunga and its collaborators. Do not reuse collectible art, photos, or tracks commercially without permission.
Event schedules update dynamically and may change. Third-party embeds (maps, players, fonts) follow their own terms. This site is provided as is.
